Calls now ring like a phone call, even with the screen off.

- **Calls over the lock screen**: an incoming call wakes the phone and shows the full Answer / Decline screen on top of the lock screen, like WhatsApp. You can answer, talk, mute and hang up without unlocking. The screen stays on while it rings.
- Tapping **Answer** in the notification picks up right there, without opening the app first.
- The **minimize arrow** asks you to unlock, then carries on in Murmur with the call as a pill at the top.
- With **Hide message text** or app lock on, the lock screen says "Murmur call" instead of who's calling.
- Android 14+ can turn off full-screen calls per app. If that happens, **Settings → Notifications** shows a shortcut to turn it back on.

---

**Install:** download **`Murmur-v1.3.2.apk`** below and open it on your phone (allow "install unknown apps" if Android asks). `Murmur-v1.3.2-debug.apk` is the debug build: same app, slower animations. Both are signed with the same key, so newer versions install over older ones and keep your chats.
